nodes.label: AIQueryService
nodes.description: Service for AI-powered SQL query generation via Groq API with security guards and schema context
nodes.code: class AIQueryService { public function ask(string $userQuery, array $userContext): array { ... Http::withToken($this->apiKey)->post('https://api.groq.com/...', [...]) ... } }

nodes.label: AIQueryService::ask
nodes.description: Main entry point: sends query to Groq LLM, extracts SQL, executes on read-only connection, returns results

nodes.label: AIQueryService::extractSql
nodes.description: Extracts SQL from markdown ```sql...``` code blocks in LLM response

nodes.label: AIQueryService::guardSql
nodes.description: Validates SQL for safety: blocks DDL/DML, prevents stacked statements, denies client role, guards password column
nodes.code: private function guardSql(string $sql, array $userContext = []): void { if (!preg_match('/^\s*(SELECT|WITH)\b/i', $sql)) throw ...; if (preg_match('/\b(DROP|DELETE|INSERT|...|GRANT|REVOKE)\b/i', $sql)) throw ...; }

nodes.label: AIQueryService::schemaContext
nodes.description: Builds cached database schema documentation with table columns, foreign keys, enums, and domain annotations

nodes.label: AIQueryService::buildSystemPrompt
nodes.description: Constructs system prompt for Groq with schema context, security rules, and user role scope

nodes.label: AIQueryService::SCHEMA_ANNOTATIONS
nodes.description: Enum-like annotations enriching schema with role values, enum members, and foreign key references for AI context

nodes.label: AIQueryService::ALLOWED_TABLES
nodes.description: Whitelist of 21 tables the AI is permitted to query (excludes sensitive ops/audit tables)
